name: dig-routing
description: Route Dig research and saved-report lookups to the current or connected computer.

interface.longDescription: An optional instruction-only companion to Dig. Use an existing local Dig connection or delegate research and saved-report lookup to an authorized connected computer, then return findings to the requesting conversation. Requires the host to expose the skill and the appropriate tools; contains no server or credentials.
defaultPrompt: Use Dig on my connected computer to research this question and return the findings here.
